Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' *[[Mynock (Helot-class)|Crew of the ''Mynock'']] }} {{Quote|An extremely well put-together little droid.|Panaka|{{Film|I}}}} '''R2-D2''', sometimes spelled '''Artoo-Detoo''' and often referred to as '''Artoo''', was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], who would participate in major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events for nearly two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] alongside the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]]. Resourceful and spunky, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] developed an adventurous personality during his over a century of operation. Inside his cylindrical frame were many arms, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and other tools that could be extended to fulfill various needs, such as [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]], [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|extinguishing]] fires, [[Holoprojector/Legends|projecting]] [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]], [[Fusioncutter/Legends|repairing]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and [[Rocket booster/Legends|flying]]. Along with his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], R2-D2 constantly found himself directly involved in pivotal moments of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]]. His bravery, coupled with his many gadgets, played large roles in saving the galaxy time and time again for more than a century. Like other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], R2-D2 could walk on two legs or use a third leg to roll across the ground. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], R2-D2 was serving the [[Royal Engineers]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] aboard [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|royal starship]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. His [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance]] work on the ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] while it was under fire allowed the queen and her crew to bypass the blockade and flee the besieged world. R2-D2 was then recognized before the queen for his work in ensuring the ship's safety. Afterwards, R2-D2 directly served the queen, playing a decisive role in [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|liberating]] Naboo and remaining with Amidala for another ten years, even as she transitioned to the role of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[24 BBY/Legends|eight years later]]. When [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempts]] on her life were made in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was assigned to protect her, R2-D2 and C-3PO accompanied the two to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and participated in a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] that started the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galaxy-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Amidala gave R2-D2 to Skywalker when he became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and the astromech droid faithfully served him throughout the war, often flying in the [[Astromech socket/Legends|droid socket]] of Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] or fighting next to him on the front lines. The war was in fact orchestrated by the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, and who brought the conflict to an end [[19 BBY/Legends|three years in]], taking Skywalker as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|wiping out]] the Jedi, slaying the Separatists and reorganizing the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the aftermath of the war, R2-D2 and C-3PO were assigned to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they served Alderaan's [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] for nineteen years. They were, however, separated from Organa during that time period, and got caught up in a wide variety of misadventures, ruining the [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Tig Fromm]], helping restore the [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[King/Legends|monarchy]], and aiding the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] in reviving [[Baobab family|his family's]] fortune, among other exploits. After rejoining the crew of the ''Tantive IV'', they became embroiled in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] entrusted R2-D2 to bring a copy of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After meeting Skywalker's son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the droids helped rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia from the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and became directly attached to the three [[Human/Legends|Humans]], helping them and their rebellion defeat the Empire and restore freedom to the galaxy. R2-D2 also assisted Luke in his training as the galaxy's last Jedi Knight. When the Rebellion later became a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], R2-D2 continued to serve Luke and the now-[[Marriage/Legends|married]] Han and Leia Solo, helping them defeat remnants of the Empire; R2-D2 notably sliced into Palpatine's [[Galaxy Gun]] and used it to destroy the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], teamed up with C-3PO and a young [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named [[Cole Fardreamer]] to foil a [[Almanian Uprising|plan]] to bomb the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and recovered a copy of the [[Caamas Document]], which allowed peace to be [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|forged]] between the New Republic and the final remnants of the Empire. When an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Species/Legends|race]] of religious zealots known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the galaxy in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], R2-D2 participated in the four-year [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conflict]] that eventually saw the invaders defeated. [[35 ABY/Legends|Six years]] later, Luke and Leia discovered the identity of their mother via holorecordings found in R2-D2's memory, and R2-D2 remained at their side during the subsequent [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The astromech droid was passed down to many subsequent generations of Skywalkers, and in [[137 ABY]], aided [[Cade Skywalker]] in fighting against a revived [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. ==Description== [[File:ArtooBlueprints-SWBTUC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|R2-D2 blueprints]] {{Quote|Don't you call me a mindless philosopher, you overweight glob of grease!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to R2-D2|{{Film|IV}}}} R2-D2 was a diminutive [[Droid/Legends|droid]], standing 0.96 meters tall. He rolled on three legs, one of which could retract into his body, and had a silver and blue domed head. His white, blue, and silver body housed many arms, sensors, and other apparatuses, many of which were not readily seen by the typical [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] eye. This often made the droid seem like a box of tricks, unexpectedly pulling out some previously unseen but very much needed device at a critical moment. It also contained a carousel device that contained a specific arm related to a specific duty, to economize space within his cylindrical body. Because of the quickness in utilizing a specific arm, it often gave off the illusion that he had an endless supply of tools. While R2-D2 contained many specialized gadgets, he was also quite good at taking the initiative and often employed unorthodox means to help his friends. R2-D2's horizontal blue slots could also be opened further, which would then send out a two-pronged, whip-like appendage, which he could use to taunt others.''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]''{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}} ===Known Features=== {{Quote|That droid's a sawed-off genius! He's laying down a smokescreen!''"
"''Your firefighting aerosol! Artoo, how do you think of these things?|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]|[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]}} Even by R2-series standards, R2-D2 had an extensive amount of features, which were both part of the R2 line and modified. R2-D2, during the Clone Wars, utilized a Brooks Propulsion rocket booster, which he used to escape and, in the case of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], offensively. After the Clone Wars, however, [[Brooks Propulsion Devices]], the company responsible for the development of his boosters, was shut down, and his rocket boosters were eventually damaged and thus could not be repaired. Despite this, however, R2 hardly regretted the loss of his ability to fly.''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'' During Post Battle of Endor R2 would be upgraded and given to Cade Skywalker and thust most likely repairing his Rocket Boosters as he escaped from a group of pirates using his booster jets. He had an extendable neck, in large part so he could be fitted into the droid section of the Naboo N-1 starfighter. However, he rarely used it, as it would result in foreign agents gaining entrance to his internal systems.

==Biography== ===In the service of the Naboo=== ====The Invasion of Naboo==== {{Quote|Clean this droid up as best you can. It deserves our gratitude.|Sabé|}} [[File:R2_repair.png|thumb|left|225px|R2-D2 repairs the shield generator of Queen Amidala's Royal Starship.]]In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], R2-D2 was in the possession of the [[Royal Engineers]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and was assigned aboard [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Royal Starship]] as a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]].{{SWPM|set=Base Set|cardname=Maintenance Droid|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/card024.jpg}} The Royal Engineers were famous for making after-market additions to their [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 units]], which rendered the droids some of the most sought-after units in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] During that year, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] created a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleships]] around Naboo in response to [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|legislation]] passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] which called for the taxation of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], and [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|began landing]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|their army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the planet. Accompanied by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the Queen and a group of her royal personnel boarded the royal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and attempted to flee the planet by breaking the blockade. When the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] of one of the Federation's battleships damaged the royal starship's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], R2-D2 and several other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] made their way through a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] to effect repairs; R2-D2 bumped into the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] on his way out of the ship. As R2-D2's droid companions were systematically blown off of the hull by [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts, the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] gave out completely until R2-D2 was able to bypass the main power drive and bring the shields back online. With the shields again intact, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] broke the blockade and fled the planet. As the ship traveled through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a dirtied R2-D2 was brought before the queen by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], the head of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], a decoy posing as the queen, thanked him for saving the lives of everyone aboard, and ordered Padmé Naberrie, actually the queen posing as a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]], to clean the droid up. Amidala cleaned R2-D2's exterior while Jar Jar Binks watched; the trio later accompanied Qui-Gon Jinn to the city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on Tatooine in search of a new [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|hyperdrive generator]]. R2-D2 accompanied Jinn and the others to the [[Wald's Parts|junk shop]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], and later to [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|the home]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a young [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] working for Watto who offered his home to the party as a reprieve from a coming sandstorm. In Skywalker's home, R2-D2 was introduced to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that the boy was building. As C-3PO was yet to be covered with an outer plating, R2-D2 candidly remarked that his parts were showing, even calling him "naked." The astromech droid then stood in the home's kitchen as the guests dined with Skywalker and his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], and later helped Skywalker make final adjustments to [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]] in time to race it in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|race]]. Despite C-3PO's shock at R2-D2's initial candor, the two droids fast developed a friendship of sorts, working on the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] together, discussing [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel, and noting the clumsy actions of Binks. On the day of the race, R2-D2 helped pull Skywalker's racer onto [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|the course]], and later stood on the sidelines with C-3PO and two of Skywalker's playmates, [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] and [[W. Wald]], who cheered their friend on. Skywalker won the race, which secured the hyperdrive generator and freed the boy from his enslavement. R2-D2 was waiting inside the royal starship and next to its [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]] as Skywalker entered the ship, and was present shortly thereafter when Jinn entered, having [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|just dueled]] a [[Darth Maul/Legends|Sith Lord]] on the planet's sand dunes. The ship and its crew traveled to the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and remained there for several days, before returning to Naboo in an effort to rid the planet of its Trade Federation presence. Onworld, R2-D2 accompanied the queen's party to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]] as she requested help from Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] of the Gungans in the impending battle. After Nass accepted, R2-D2 attended an informal council of war, and projected a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Theed as plans were made to lay siege to the city. [[File:FuneralAttendees_ep1ig.jpg|thumb|right|250px|R2-D2 attends the funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn.]]Amidala, along with her handmaidens, bodyguards, Jinn and Kenobi, Skywalker, and R2-D2 [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|stormed]] the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] through [[Theed Hangar/Legends|its hangar]]; after the area was cleared of battle droids, R2-D2 was pulled into the droid socket of a [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|Naboo Royal Starfighter]] that Skywalker had taken refuge in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of. After locating the firing controls, Skywalker destroyed several [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] with the ship's guns, but found the ship in an automatic pilot mode. R2-D2 was able to override the auto-pilot, but only after the ship had made its way to a [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|space battle]] that was raging above the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The astromech droid instructed his pilot to return to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], but Skywalker refused, and joined [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] as they assaulted the Trade Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid control ship]]. Shortly into the battle, Skywalker's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] was hit and made a crash landing inside one of the control ship's hangars. Firing [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]], Skywalker was able to destroy it, which played a large part in the day's victory over the Trade Federation. Following the victory, R2-D2 attended the [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been [[Shiak|slain]] during the battle by the same [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] he had fought on Tatooine. R2-D2 was later present at a [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|ceremony]] which celebrated the battle's victory, and stood by as Amidala presented Boss Nass with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people's]] [[Globe of Peace/Legends|Globe of Peace]]. ====Serving a Senator==== {{Quote|Don't worry. We have Artoo with us.|Anakin Skywalker to Padmé Amidala|{{Film|II}}}} R2-D2 would remain in Amidala's service for another ten years, even transitioning with her from the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] to the Galactic Senate in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] [[22 BBY/Legends|Three years after]] her appointment to the senate, Amidala traveled from Naboo to Coruscant to vote against the senate's proposed [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], but chose a [[Cordé/Legends|handmaiden]] to pose as her and to make the journey in an official ship, while Amidala flew in a Naboo Royal starfighter with R2-D2 in the droid socket. After their arrival at a landing platform on Coruscant, a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|bomb detonated]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the crew of the yacht; R2-D2 followed as Amidala's head of security Captain [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] rushed her to safety. Anakin Skywalker, now a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and his Master Obi-Wan Kenobi were assigned by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to protect the senator from further assassination attempts, and R2-D2 was programmed to warn the two Jedi if anyone intruded into [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|her apartment]] while she slept. Despite his programming, R2-D2 failed to detect the insertion of two [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Kouhun/Legends|kouhuns]] into Amidala's bedroom, which had been administered through a hole in the window created by an [[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN courier droid]]. Although Skywalker [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] and killed the creatures, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic felt that Coruscant was an unsafe place for Amidala, and agreed to delay the vote on the Military Creation Act so that she might lay low on Naboo under the watchful [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of Skywalker. [[File:PadmeArtooAnakinPalaceCourtyard-AOTC.jpg|thumb|left|300px|R2-D2 accompanies Amidala and Skywalker to Naboo.]]R2-D2 accompanied the two onto a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] whose voyage saw them posing as refugees, and brought them food in spite of the protests of a serving droid. After the ship's arrival at Theed, R2-D2 accompanied Skywalker and Amidala to the Royal Palace and quietly waited outside the Royal Court as the two met with Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]]. Several days later, he journeyed with the two to Tatooine in [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|Amidala's yacht]] as a restless Skywalker searched for his mother, and accompanied them to Watto's junk shop in Mos Espa. When Watto directed them to a [[Lars homestead/Legends|moisture farm]], the yacht was flown to the [[Great Chott salt flat/Legends|Great Chott salt flat]], and Amidala instructed R2-D2 to remain with the ship while she and Skywalker went to the [[Moisture farm/Legends|farm]]. While aboard the ship, R2-D2 received a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] message from Kenobi, who was on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and whose long-range [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] had been damaged by Jango Fett; Kenobi asked Skywalker to relay the message to the Jedi Council on Coruscant. Leaving the ship, R2-D2 found Skywalker, Amidala, C-3PO, and the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] attending a [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|funeral for Shmi Skywalker]], and informed them of the message. When C-3PO translated his binary beeps and whistles, Skywalker and Amidala returned to the ship and relayed the message to Coruscant. Seeing that Kenobi had been captured by droidekas while recording the message, the two decided to fly to Geonosis and rescue him. They were joined by R2-D2 and C-3PO, the latter having been given to Skywalker by his stepbrother [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]. ===Entering the Clone Wars=== ====The Battle of Geonosis==== {{Quote|Where are you going now? You don't know what's out there! Have you no sense at all? Idiot!|C-3PO to R2-D2|}} [[File:Skyrocketsinflight.jpg|thumb|right|250px|R2-D2 soars through a battle-droid factory on Geonosis.]]Landing the yacht inside an exhaust vent on Geonosis, Skywalker and Amidala set out, leaving the droids behind. R2-D2 insisted on following them, but C-3PO disagreed and claimed to be in charge. R2-D2 ignored his friend and set out, and was ultimately followed by a reluctant C-3PO. Within the planet's [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] swarmed by the droids in flight from Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; the droids soon discovered an entrance to a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|battle droid factory]], within which Skywalker and Amidala were battling Geonosian warriors. Hoping to reach them, R2-D2 knocked C-3PO off of the platform on which they stood, before activating his [[Rocket booster/Legends|booster jets]] and soaring through the factory. Finding Amidala trapped in a large bucket, R2-D2 landed on a bridge and [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into a [[computer terminal]] with his [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]], successfully saving the senator from being doused by molten ore. He also loosed the bucket from the mechanical arm which held it, spilling Amidala onto the factory floor. Surrounded by enemies, Amidala and Skywalker were captured and sentenced to die with Kenobi in a Geonosian [[Petranaki arena|execution arena]]. The timely arrival of [[Jedi assault team/Legends|200 Jedi]] saved them, but [[Jedi Order/Legends|the Jedi]] soon found themselves in a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|fierce battle]] with hundreds of armed droids fighting in the name of the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. R2-D2 entered the battle and discovered C-3PO's head attached to a battle droid's body. Using his cable gun to detach the head, R2-D2 dragged it across the arena and grafted it to the correct torso. As the battle droids overwhelmed the Jedi, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with a large force of the newly commissioned [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and the fighting spilled out of the arena, soon leaving R2-D2, C-3PO, and the young [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as its sole occupants. The Republic Army won the battle, launching a [[Clone Wars/Legends|galactic war]] between the Republic and the Confederacy. Shortly after the battle, R2-D2 and C-3PO accompanied Amidala and Skywalker back to Naboo, where they were the lone witnesses to a [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|wedding between the two]] in the planet's [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. ====From Amidala to Skywalker==== {{Quote|I'm going to look for Master Yoda.''"
"''Alone?''"
"''No. You two will accompany me.|Senator Amidala to her droids on Ilum|{{CW|16}}}} [[File:R2D2-CloneWars.svg|thumb|left|125px|R2-D2 during the early stages of the Clone Wars]]R2-D2 remained with Amidala on Coruscant during the initial battles of the war,{{CW|1}} as did C-3PO, who had been given to the senator by Skywalker as a [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] gift.''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' The three witnessed Skywalker depart the planet in a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] on his way to [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|lay siege]] to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the droids were traveling with Amidala in her Royal yacht while the ship was host to Yoda. After Yoda convinced Amidala and Captain Typho to make a detour, the ship headed to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] on a rescue mission of the Jedi [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]].{{CW|15}} The Jedi Master set out into the planet's blizzard alone, but a worried Amidala, after being assured by R2-D2 that his [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were functioning properly in the snowy weather, soon set out to find him with the droids in tow. During the search, R2-D2's sensors detected several incoming objects, which turned out to be three [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] Separatist [[Chameleon droid/Legends|Chameleon droids]]. Amidala destroyed all three, and the trio was greeted by their three wayward Jedi, Yoda concerned that the location of Ilum's [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] had been discovered by the Separatists. Slicing into one of the destroyed droids, R2-D2 discovered and revealed a hologram of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy, giving instructions to destroy the caves. After Skywalker was elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight, he gave his former [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]] to Amidala as a gift. R2-D2 was present when she received the hairpiece; in return, Amidala gave the astromech droid to her husband. Traveling to a hangar, R2-D2 showed Skywalker a hologram of Amidala indicating the droid's new ownership, much to Skywalker's delight. R2-D2 was then locked into the Jedi Knight's starfighter, and the two departed the planet.{{CW|21}} R2-D2 flew with Skywalker in space combat throughout much of the war, including a [[Unidentified space battle (Saesee Tiin)|battle]] where Skywalker saved Jedi Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] from [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]].{{CW|22}} Skywalker programmed a large amount of tactical data and locations of Republic bases into the droid's memory, and broke protocol by never giving R2-D2 a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]].{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}} The droid was with Skywalker when he returned to Coruscant to visit Amidala. ====The new Padawan, the missing Huttlet==== {{Quote|If there's a way out of here, Artooie will find it.|Ahsoka Tano|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]}} When the [[Christophsian/Legends|native population]] of the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] appealed to the Jedi for aid in repelling an invading Separatist force, Kenobi, now a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]], and Skywalker, a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]], arrived in the planet's [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] with a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and R2-D2. Following a disastrous ambush by battle droids, R2-D2 watched as [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody," and Clone Captain [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," analyzed the recovered head of [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]], a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], in the communications center of the Republic base. When the two troopers discovered a [[Slick/Legends|spy]] in their midst, they rushed out of the center, but later returned and employed R2-D2 in locating any transmissions the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] had made. Plugging into a computer terminal, R2-D2 discovered a number of external communications that had taken place every few days in an irregular pattern. He traced them to the barracks of the [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] Slick, which ultimately resulted in Cody and Rex fettering out the traitor.{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} [[File:R2-KT_meeting.png|thumb|right|200px|R2-D2 and [[R2-KT/Legends|R2-KT]] aboard Skywalker's transport, bound for Teth]] A large force of battle droids marched on the city, but was [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|repelled by the Jedi and the Republic army]]. As a second wave arrived, R2-D2 was in the thick of the battle, but retreated to the safety of the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon]] as the cannons fired at the droids' [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. After the droids retreated from the overwhelming cannon fire, a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] arrived on-planet from Coruscant and landed in the City's [[City Plaza (Christophsis)|plaza]]. R2-D2 followed Kenobi and Skywalker to the plaza, and squealed in delight as the shuttle's lone occupant disembarked: [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Skywalker's new Padawan learner. As the Separatist army set up a deflector shield, R2-D2 joined Skywalker, Kenobi, Tano, and Rex at a council of war, where a plan was hatched to disable the shield. During the ensuing firefight, R2-D2 again remained with the Republic's cannons, which decisively ended the battle following the sabotage of the Separatists' shield generator. In the wake of the victory, Yoda arrived in Crystal City and ordered Skywalker and Tano to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|the kidnapped son]] of the notorious [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]; R2-D2 traveled with them to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world and was present in the hangar of Skywalker's [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class transport]] while Skywalker was briefed on the situation planetside, and while Tano bragged of her exploits on Christophsis to a group of clone troopers. Skywalker and Tano led their troops to a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|successful siege]] of a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] [[B'omarr Monastery|Monastery]] occupied by Separatist forces, and rescued Rotta the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] from within. Outside the castle, R2-D2 sat in Skywalker's starfighter and projected a holographic transmission from Kenobi, which was cut short by the arrival of several Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]]. R2-D2 jettisoned himself from the starfighter mere seconds before it received a barrage of blasterfire and exploded. As [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] swarmed the exterior of the castle, R2-D2 followed Tano inside, and was joined by Skywalker and several clone troopers before the castle's door slammed shut. Tano quickly devised an escape plan, and brought R2-D2 and Skywalker to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal where the astromech droid sliced in and located a backdoor landing platform. En route to the platform, the trio was met by the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and several B2 droids, but before a skirmish could ensue, R2-D2 activated a trap door in the floor, sending everyone present plunging down a long chute and into a small arena. As Skywalker [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Ventress, Tano neutralized the droid threat; a second group of B2 droids arrived in an overhead gallery but were assailed by R2-D2 and knocked into the arena below. The distraction offered by a [[Jungle rancor/Legends|jungle rancor]] present in the arena allowed an outgunned Ventress to escape, and the trio continued to the landing platform.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] [[File:Dragonflypursuit.png|thumb|left|250px|Fleeing from Asajj Ventress, R2-D2 follows Skywalker and Tano to a secret landing platform on Teth.]]Arriving at the platform, they were again greeted Ventress, this time with several droidekas in tow, but R2-D2 was able to close the door to the platform before their foes arrived. After Skywalker leapt off of the platform and onto the back of a [[Can-cell/Legends|large, winged insectoid]], he tamed the beast and used it to tackled Ventress, who had cut through the door with [[Interlocking hilt|her lightsabers]] and was dueling Tano. As Tano joined her Master on the beast's back, R2-D2 activated his booster rockets and followed them to Ventress's secret landing platform, located on a nearby mesa. The Huttlet was strapped to R2-D2 as the two Jedi attempted to start the engines of the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], a freighter they discovered, but it was R2-D2 who was able to successfully get the ship running. Unable to rendezvous with the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'', the trio was forced to take the freighter to Tatooine and deliver the Huttlet directly to his father. R2-D2 programmed the coordinates into the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]], and it jumped to hyperspace. Above Tatooine, the freighter was attacked by vulture droids, the last of which was destroyed when R2-D2 plugged into a computer terminal and fired the freighter's cannons at it. Damaged in the firefight, the freighter crashed into the planet's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], which forced the trio to journey to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on foot. When Skywalker [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the presence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], he suspected a nearby [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and set off to draw it towards him and away from the Huttlet. He left Rotta with R2-D2 and Tano, who made it to Jabba's Palace without incident until three [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] rose from the sand and attacked them. R2-D2 electrocuted one with his [[Electro-shock prod/Legends|droid shock arm]] before being knocked away, and it fell to Tano to destroy all three with her lightsaber. The two then entered the palace and returned the Huttlet, which, coupled with a holo-transmission from Senator Amidala on Coruscant identifying Jabba's uncle [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] as the responsible party for the kidnapping, placated an angry Jabba and saved the lives of the two Jedi. ====In the hands of Grievous==== {{Quote|You can't replace Artoo.|Anakin Skywalker upon receiving a new Astromech droid|}} When the Jedi Council received intelligence that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Armies]], intended to [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|invade]] the planet of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], they dispatched three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] under Skywalker's command to blockade the [[Both system]]. When six [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Confederate frigates]] arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Skywalker led [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|the starfighters]] of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] out to meet them, with R2-D2 flying in the general's droid socket. When the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] were outflanked by several Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|Walkers]] hiding on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], Grievous fled his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] in [[Soulless One/Legends|his personal starfighter]], and was pursued closely by Skywalker and R2-D2. A piece of shrapnel from an exploding frigate became lodged in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Skywalker's fighter]], and he lost both control of the ship and consciousness; the Jedi was soon recovered by Rex, but R2-D2 was salvaged from the starfighter's remains by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] and brought aboard Nachkt's freighter, the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']]. [[File:R2-taken_apart.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Grievous watches Gha Nachkt disassemble R2-D2.]]Nachkt suspected that the droid's memory contained valuable Republic information, and accordingly fitted R2-D2 with a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] and contacted Grievous, offering the droid in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. En route to a rendezvous with the General, Nachkt slept in the freighter's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], which allowed R2-D2 to lose his restraining bolt and escape from the closet in which he was being held captive. As he rolled down the ship's corridors, he was pursued by an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]], but managed to slice into a computer terminal, shutting a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] between the sentinel and himself, and opening a trap door beneath the sentinel that jettisoned it into space. However, the mayhem woke Nachkt, who found R2-D2 and refitted the droid with his restraining bolt. Again a captive, R2-D2 was inspected by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the Separatist-allied [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], who boarded the ''Vulture's Claw'' with the hope of purchasing a [[Espionage droid|spy droid]]. Although he showed an interest in R2-D2, Nachkt informed him that the astromech already had a customer.''[[The Clone Wars: Discount]]'' As the ''Vulture's Claw'' arrived at [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a Confederate [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] in the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]], R2-D2 again worked at escaping his confinement. Cutting through a wall in the closet with his buzzsaw, he accessed a control panel and sent an audio transmission through the freighter's broadcast antennae, which was ultimately picked up by Skywalker. Nachkt discovered the droid's actions and electrocuted him with an [[ion prod]]; the Trandoshan then landed the freighter at the listening post and brought R2-D2 before Grievous. The General instructed Nachkt to take the droid apart and extract any information on the Republic from his memory, and Nachkt complied, discovering that R2-D2's memory contained every single Republic formation and strategy. Grievous killed Nachkt for demanding more credits, and then instructed several of his Magnaguards to reconstruct R2-D2 and bring him to a secure location after learning that Republic troops [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|had boarded the station]]. As the astromech was carried through the station's corridors, Skywalker, who had traced R2-D2's broadcast to the [[Star system/Legends|system]], located him and destroyed every Magnaguard with his lightsaber. As the skirmish occurred, a partially reconstructed R2-D2 managed to mostly reattach his arms and dome, and then electrocuted a Magnaguard as its destroyed arm attempted to grab Skywalker's leg.{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}} [[File:Epguide007.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The duel of the droids]]Skywalker was happy to see his friend again, but was promptly [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] by [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], his replacement astromech droid who was in fact a Confederate spy. After R2-D2 and Skywalker raced back to the ''Twilight'', which Skywalker had docked in one of the station's hangar bays, R3-S6 revealed his true allegiance by shutting all the doors to the hangar and activating several derelict vulture droids, who, along with a group of B2 battle droids, attacked Skywalker, R2-D2, and a group of clone troopers. Skywalker ordered R2-D2 to an outer platform to see if there was a way to open the hangar door. After rolling across a bridge, R2-D2 began to interact with a computer terminal, but was accosted by R3-S6, who had followed him to the platform. The two astromechs began shooting electricity at each other, but R2-D2's lightning proved to be more powerful and incapacitated his foe. He successfully opened the hangar door, but was again attacked by R3-S6, and responded by shooting oil at his opponent. Having been rigged with explosives that had been recently been detonated, the station began to weaken, causing the bridge to buckle and begin to collapse. R3-S6 began to tumble off, but held on by firing his cable gun at R2-D2. As the two droids slowly began to slip towards the edge of the collapsing bridge, R2-D2 fired his booster rockets, setting fire to the space between them, and used his buzzsaw to cut the cable, sending R3-S6 rocketing off of the bridge and towards his destruction. R2-D2 then flew into Skywalker's waiting starfighter with the aid of his rockets, and the ship sped away from the exploding station. ====Chasing the ''Malevolence''==== {{Quote|Artoo! Program the navicomputer. Be ready to get us out of here.''"
"''You forgot. We turned him off!|Skywalker and Tano, preparing to flee from the ''Malevolence''|{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}}} News began to spread through the Republic of a Separatist weapon that had destroyed over a dozen Republic [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and left no survivors; when Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was presumed destroyed in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], Skywalker, Tano, and R2-D2 took the ''Twilight'' from the [[Bith system/Legends|Bith system]] to investigate, despite instructions from [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] stating that they were to remain with their fleet and protect vital convoy missions. Arriving in the Abregado system, R2-D2 tuned the ''Twilight''{{'s}} [[Life-form scanner/Legends|scanners]] to detect lifeforms, and received a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmission from Kenobi, who instructed Skywalker to rendezvous with his fleet. As the three prepared to leave the system, R2-D2 discovered a lifeform reading on the ship's emergency channel and traced the signal to a specific area of the shattered remains of Koon's fleet. When Tano sensed Koon's presence, the three were able to employ a [[Power harpoon launcher|tow cable]] in bringing an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] aboard their ship which was housing Koon and three clone troopers. The joy of the recovery was cut short when the Separatist's secret weapon arrived in-system: A [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] of prodigious proportions called the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which sported massive [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] that it used to disable its prey. R2-D2 was shut off with the rest of the ''Twilight''{{'s}} systems in a bid to avoid detection from the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship's]] sensors, but when the gambit failed, the astromech droid was reactivated and plotted a hyperjump away from the system. Having successfully escaped from the ion cannons' blast, the ''Twilight'' rendezvoused with the Star Destroyer [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Hoping to acquire a group of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to use against the heavy [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], Skywalker brought R2-D2, Tano, and the clone pilots of [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] in the ''Twilight'' to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus Testing Facility]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet of [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] that possessed such a group. Aboard the station, R2-D2 plugged into a computer terminal and uploaded falsified documents that a [[Unidentified Gran worker|protesting worker]] needed into the station's computer system, which claimed that Skywalker had permission to take the untested fighters.''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'' With new fighters to their name, Shadow Squadron returned to the ''Resolute'', where they were briefed by Skywalker and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]; R2-D2 assisted in the briefing by projecting a hologram of the ''Malevolence'' while Skywalker outlined the squadron's attack strategy: bomb the cruiser's bridge superstructure. R2-D2 then joined Skywalker and Tano in one of the bombers; Skywalker would be commanding Shadow Squadron while Tano acted as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. Having received intelligence that their target was heading towards the Republic's [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], Shadow Squadron took a shortcut through the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] in order to cut the ''Malevolence'' off.{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} [[File:Shadow_Squadron_briefing.png|thumb|right|300px|Shadow Squadron is briefed by R2-D2, Skywalker, and Admiral Yularen aboard the ''Resolute''.]]The shortcut necessitated passage through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], which saw the squadron and Master Koon, acting as its [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|fighter escort]], dodge through nesting giant [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray]] mantas. Passing through mostly unscathed, the squadron beat the ''Malevolence'' to the medical center, but was reduced to half of its strength when five bombers were lost to vulture droids and the cruiser's massive ion cannons. Unable to destroy the bridge, the squadron directed its efforts at one of the ion cannons at Tano's suggestion, firing proton torpedoes at the weapon. The [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|damage inflicted]] caused the ''Malevolence'' to nearly tear itself apart when it attempted to fire, incapacitating both weapons and its hyperdrive. The ''Resolute'' prepared to destroy the derelict cruiser, but held off when Senator Amidala's yacht, having arrived in-system due to false intelligence, was brought aboard by the damaged ship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. Bringing R2-D2 with them, Skywalker and Kenobi took the ''Twilight'' aboard to rescue her.{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} Arriving inside the ''Malevolence'', R2-D2 was ordered to remain at the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] entrance, where he was soon commed by Skywalker and told to shut down a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]] [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]]. After complying by means of a sliced computer terminal, the astromech droid was told to locate C-3PO, who had arrived with Amidala but had gotten lost. R2-D2 found his friend, and the two rendezvoused with Skywalker and Amidala before meeting Kenobi at the ''Twilight''. The task of powering up its engines and releasing its docking clamp fell to R2-D2, who then scanned the ''Malevolence'' and discovered that it was powering up its hyperdrive. Owing to sabotage performed by Skywalker and Amidala, the hyperdrive caused the cruiser to explode as the ''Twilight'' sped to safety. Despite the victory, Grievous, who had been in command of the cruiser, escaped, and Skywalker began dedicating his efforts to tracking the General down. R2-D2 stayed by his owner's side aboard the ''Resolute'' as Skywalker forsook sleep in his task.{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} However, the Jedi Knight's focus would soon shift to Count Dooku; R2-D2 aided Skywalker in making his starfighter appear damaged in a ruse that ended with Skywalker allowing himself to be captured by a Confederate ''Munificent''-class star frigate commanded by Dooku near [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]].''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]'' ====A white truce, a blue shadow==== {{Quote|Might we go inside, Master Anakin? Artoo would like to get out of the cold.|C-3PO on Orto Plutonia|{{TCW|Trespass}}}} R2-D2 and C-3PO were again reunited during a trip to [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], the latter having been lent to Skywalker by his wife for the mission to the icy world. When contact was lost with a planetside [[Glid Station/Legends|military outpost]], Skywalker and Kenobi brought the droids and a contingent of [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|Clone cold assault troopers]] to investigate, and were accompanied by Senator [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], as well as [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]], [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], due to the planet's location in [[Pantora/Legends|Pantoran]] space. When the Jedi discovered that the clone troopers stationed on Pantora had been wiped out by a group of local [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], Cho declared [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|war]] on the natives, but the conflict was quickly halted when Chuchi received permission from the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Speaker of the Assembly/Legends|Speaker of the Assembly]] to negotiate peace. R2-D2 and C-3PO accompanied Chuchi, the Jedi, and what clone troopers were not fighting to the scene of the battle, where Chuchi made peace with [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]], the Talz's tribal leader. The two droids met again when R2-D2, Kenobi, Skywalker, and Tano [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|landed on Naboo]] in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], having been sent by the Jedi Council in response to intelligence suggesting that a Separatist bio-lab had been set up on the planet. After being greeted by C-3PO, Typho, and the Gungan [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]] in a hangar of Theed's Royal Palace, Skywalker sent Tano and Bow to locate the laboratory, while he, Kenobi, and R2-D2 were shown a hologram of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] that had been discovered inside the head of a B1 battle droid. The Jedi managed to locate [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|Vindi's laboratory]] in the planet's swamps and arrest the mad doctor,{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}} but Skywalker, Kenobi, and R2-D2 were forced to [[Mission to Iego/Legends|take]] the ''Twilight'' to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] when Tano, Amidala, Jar-Jar Binks, Rex, and several other clone troopers became trapped in the laboratory with an airborne stream of the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] that Vindi had been synthesizing.{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}} [[File:AnakinArtoo-SOR.jpg|thumb|left|325px|Master and droid tinker with Tano's starfighter above Ryloth.]]The two Jedi were able to obtain a root of Iego's [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], which was a necessary ingredient in the antidote for the virus, but were unable to leave the planet due to the presence of [[Drol/Legends|Drol]], a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] that the Separatists had installed in the planet's orbit. After one unsuccessful attempt to pass through it, the ''Twilight'' landed in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] city of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]], and R2-D2 received and amplified a HoloNet transmission from Amidala and Tano, both of whom were suffering from the effects of the virus. A plan was hatched to break through Drol, and as the ''Twilight'' left the city, several vulture droids that the Separatists had left on the planet were [[Slave circuit|slave-rigged]] to the control of R2-D2. Via a computer terminal, R2-D2 sent the droid ships on [[Ramming/Legends|suicide runs]] into Drol's laser generators, destroying the [[Automated defense system|defense system]] and allowing the ''Twilight'' passage out of the system. R2-D2 set a course for Naboo, where the antidote was synthesized and the affected parties cured. The ''Resolute'', along with the Star Destroyers [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] and [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']], were soon after called to the planet of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] after [[Twi'lek/Legends|its inhabitants]] were enslaved by [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] of the Separatist-allied [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. An [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|initial skirmish]] above the planet saw the destruction of the ''Redeemer'', and when its companion ships fled, R2-D2 assisted Skywalker in working on [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|his Padawan's starfighter]] while Skywalker and Tano concocted a plan to break the blockade. The damaged ''Defender'' was evacuated, save for R2-D2 and Skywalker, who piloted it straight into the lead Separatist control ship. Prior to the crash, the two fled the ''Defender'' in an escape pod, which was recovered by the ''Resolute''. With the blockade broken, Kenobi's troops could mount a ground assault of the planet.{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} ===New threats=== ====A cunning bounty hunter==== {{Quote|Artoo says we're close…stay sharp.|Skywalker during the Battle of Devaron|{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}}} In the employ of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, the secret leader of the Confederacy, a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stole]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],{{TCW|Holocron Heist}} but was subsequently pursued to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] by the ''Resolute''. The ''Resolute'' [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|targeted]] the hyperdrive of a ''Munificent''-class frigate that [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of the Separatist-allied Trade Federation, had lent to Bane, and the bounty [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] found himself trapped in [[Devaron system/Legends|the system]]; R2-D2, Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and a group of clone troopers took several AT-TE walkers to the hull of the frigate in an attempt to board and recover the holocron. R2-D2 opened a hatch, allowing the party to board, and joined them as they stormed the bridge. Plugging into a computer terminal, R2-D2 discovered a hologram of Bane indicating that he had taken the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]] from the captured Jedi Master [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], and located the detention area where Ropal was being held. The party found Ropal dead, but were able to locate Bane with the help of R2-D2's [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]]. They followed him into a hangar that was filled with battle droids, and a fierce firefight ensued that saw Bane disable the ship's [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity]]. Using his booster rockets, R2-D2 turned the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] back on, and, with the droids defeated, the boarding party fled the ship in a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]]. Upon their return to the ''Resolute'', it was discovered that Bane had donned the armor of a clone trooper and had fled with them; Bane quickly escaped the ''Resolute'' with a list of all known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in the galaxy that he had obtained by combining the holocron and the Kyber crystal.{{TCW|Children of the Force}} [[File:AhsokaZeroG-CoD.jpg|thumb|right|340px|R2-D2 and Tano in zero gravity]]Skywalker and Tano [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|captured Bane]] on Naboo and brought him to the ''Resolute'', where, with the aid of R2-D2, they investigated the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter's [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|fighter]] and discovered that he had recently been to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Hoping to find a higher power that they suspected Bane to be working for, the three [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|took]] the ''Twilight'' to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] planet. After landing, R2-D2 opened the door to a [[Mining station/Legends|mining station]] and allowed Skywalker and Tano access, and followed them inside, later opening another door that allowed the two Jedi to flee the station with two recovered infants, [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]] and [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]]. ====Deadly new weapons==== {{Quote|Oh, hello! You're not in trouble again, are you?|C-3PO to R2-D2|{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}}} Soon after the mission to Mustafar, R2-D2 and Skywalker [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|accompanied]] C-3PO, Amidala, Typho, and Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] on Amidala's [[J-type star skiff|star skiff]] from Coruscant to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], where Amidala parleyed with Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the Trade Federation while simultaneously spying on Clovis; both Dod and Clovis were suspected of being in league with the Confederacy. R2-D2 and Skywalker initially remained with the skiff outside [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|Dod's palace]], but Skywalker, disguised as a pilot, infiltrated the fortress and returned with a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that Amidala had stolen. R2-D2 took the datacard and prepared the skiff for takeoff, which Typho piloted away from the planet after Skywalker, Amidala, and C-3PO returned. The datacard contained tactical coordinates for a new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]] being constructed on Geonosis,{{TCW|Senate Spy}} and R2-D2 accompanied Skywalker and several other Jedi to the planet as Republic forces [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|laid siege]] to the factory. R2-D2 projected a hologram of the target as Skywalker and Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] planned an attack.{{TCW|Weapons Factory}} R2-D2 later joined a clone escort that included Skywalker, Kenobi, Cody, and Rex; the group was aboard the starship [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] in an effort to ensure the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and several other Senators belonging to Kryze's [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]] safe passage from Satine's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to Coruscant. As it was suspected that Kryze's enemies, the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], were allied with the Confederacy, R2-D2 and the clone troopers aboard patrolled the ship's cargo hold in search of any suspicious droid activity. When R2-D2 discovered a solitary clone trooper helmet, his agitated beeping and whistling, coupled with the disappearance of troopers [[Mixer/Legends|Mixer]] and [[Redeye/Legends|Redeye]], prompted Rex to contact Skywalker, whose arrival resulted in R2-D2's discovery of an empty cargo box and an [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probe]] droid. The probe was destroyed by Skywalker and the clones, but its mangled remains began spewing legions of tiny [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killers]], some of which R2-D2 electrocuted with his droid shock arm. The astromech went on to electrocute one more probe killer, just as it was about to strike at Rex's throat. Skywalker and the clone troopers destroyed the remaining probes, as well as several B2 battle droids that arrived on the ship via three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] and the traitorous Senator [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]], and the ship arrived safely at Coruscant.{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}} When Separatist forces [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|attacked]] the native [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], the long campaign worried the Supreme Chancellor, who was interested in the planet's fuel resources. Palpatine approved the use of the Republic's newest weapon, the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], and R2-D2 accompanied Skywalker and Mace Windu to Malastare to oversee the weapon's detonation. The bomb was dropped on advancing Separatist forces, releasing an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] that short-circuited the systems of the battle droids, but creating a sinkhole in the ground. R2-D2 joined Skywalker, Windu, Rex, Dug leader [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]], creator of the bomb Doctor [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]], and a hologram of the Supreme Chancellor at a round-table discussion regarding the retrieval of clones that had fallen into the sinkhole and the signing of a [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|treaty]] that would secure the planet's fuel reserves for the Republic. Skywalker left to negotiate with the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Dug Council]], but soon commed R2-D2 and told him to ready his starfighter. The two piloted the ship into the sinkhole, where Windu and several clones were battling a [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], a massive creature that the bomb's detonation had awakened.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} [[File:Riding_Artoo2.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker rides R2-D2 away from the Zillo Beast.]] A swipe from the beast caused the fighter to crash, and as it approached the downed craft, Skywalker yanked R2-D2 out of the droid socket and rode the droid to safety via R2-D2's booster rockets. He told the droid to get to safety, but R2-D2, again using his rockets, remained in the vicinity of the beast as Skywalker attacked it. When the Jedi Knight leapt off of the Zillo Beast's head, R2-D2 positioned himself beneath his master's trajectory, allowing Skywalker to land on the droid and safely ride him out of the sinkhole. The Dugs began dropping bombs into the sinkhole, but found the weapons unable to penetrate the beast's armored scales. R2-D2 joined the two Jedi, Rex, and Boll as they contacted the Supreme Chancellor and requested permission to spare the innocent creature's life. Skywalker proposed using stun cannons on gaps in the beast's armor to put it to sleep and transport it off of the planet, and when Boll convinced Palpatine to acquiesce, the plan was successfully executed. R2-D2 was present in [[Doge's Palace|Urus's palace]] as the Council signed a treaty welcoming them into the Republic. The Zillo Beast was then transported to Coruscant, and R2-D2, Skywalker, and Windu accompanied it there, meeting the Supreme Chancellor on a landing pad as he placed the beast in Dr. Boll's care. Opinions on what to do with the beast differed greatly within the small circle of those who knew of its existence. When Senator Amidala caught wind of Palpatine's plan to kill it, she contacted Kenobi, who invited Skywalker to meet him in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate building]]. R2-D2 accompanied his master and greeted C-3PO, who was attending Amidala and Kenobi. The Senator convinced her husband to appeal to his friend Palpatine, and the droids joined their masters in appearing before Palpatine in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]]. As Skywalker and Amidala discussed their options with Palpatine and [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], the Zillo Beast meanwhile escaped from its captivity and began [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|charging]] through Coruscant's cityscape. R2-D2 displayed a hologram to Skywalker from one of the clone troopers attempting to halt it, but when the beast reached the Chancellor's office, everyone present evacuated through an emergency escape route. Amedda had previously excused himself from the discussion, but Palpatine, Skywalker, Amidala, R2-D2, and C-3PO boarded an [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|executive ship]] piloted by a [[Unidentified Senate Commando (Zillo Beast incident)/Legends|Senate Commando]]. As the commando took the ship into the air, it was grabbed by one of the Zillo Beast's massive hands. Skywalker used his lightsaber to cleave the ship clean in half, sending the bow and all six passengers sliding down the exterior of the Senate Rotunda. R2-D2 skidded down the side of the building, and used his tow cable to catch himself in place. C-3PO landed atop him, but the astromech droid soon disengaged himself from the cable and used his booster rockets to make his way over to Palpatine. The [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] sacrificed himself to the rampaging Zillo beast as the Chancellor rode a flying R2-D2 to safety. Clone troopers in LAAT [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] used [[Gas bomb/Legends|gas bombs]] to kill the creature and end the threat it posed to Coruscant's [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]], and the poison they emitted was [[Force barrier/Legends|held back]] with the Force by Skywalker, as well as Yoda and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who had been attempting to engage the beast. R2-D2, Palpatine, and the three Jedi remained safe from the poison gas, as did Amidala and C-3PO, who had also safely landed. The following morning, the entire party was present as the Zillo Beast's corpse was taken away from the scene. ====The fighting thickens==== {{Quote|Your astromech is programmed to feel?''"
"''Artoo is kind of a…special case. He's got a lot of personality, that's all.|Mace Windu and Skywalker on Vanqor|{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}}} When Skywalker and Windu were sent to the Star Destroyer [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] to greet a detachment of [[Clone cadet/Legends|Clone cadets]] from the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]], R2-D2 stayed at his master's side, and was present when the group of youngsters were shown the ship's bridge. Several of the cadets were given the opportunity to fire the Destroyer's guns at [[Skeet/Legends|skeet]] targets launched by Sergeant [[Stew (clone gunner)/Legends|Stew]], and R2-D2 bore witness to Boba Fett, now a bounty hunter, hit all of his targets with one shot. Fett was infiltrating the group of his brethren in an attempt to avenge [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father's]] death and kill Windu. When Fett [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|sabotaged]] the ship, R2-D2 was on the bridge when Skywalker unsuccessfully attempted to persuade Admiral [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] to evacuate the failing Destroyer, and then evacuated with Skywalker in the Jedi Knight's interceptor. As the ''Endurance'' crashed onto the planet Vanqor, R2-D2 and Skywalker took their interceptor to rescue the young clone cadets from an escape pod that Fett had left them in after escaping on his ship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].{{TCW|Death Trap}} [[File:Gundark_grabs_Artoo.png|thumb|right|325px|R2-D2 battles a Gundark on Vanqor.]] As the occupants of the many jettisoned escape pods were rescued, Skywalker and Windu [[Mission to Vanqor/Legends|took]] their fighters planetside to search for Kilian and his command crew. Setting down behind the crashed Star Destroyer, they proceeded on foot along with R2-D2 and Windu's astromech [[R8-B7/Legends|R8-B7]]. R2-D2 spotted several [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] following them, but the group soldiered on, and R2-D2 discovered the corpse of a clone trooper that had been shot following the crash. The two Jedi proceeded to the ship's bridge and ordered the droids to remain on the ground and scan for any additional survivors. Instead, the droids found two gundarks, who ripped R8-B7 apart. R2-D2's attempts to help his companion saw him swatted away. Before the gundarks could seize him, however, they were scared off by falling debris from an explosion on the bridge. R2-D2 boarded the downed vessel and found the two Jedi trapped under a pile of debris; when he attempted to move it, Skywalker warned him that the effort would cause the entire bridge to collapse. The droid was thus instructed to return to the starfighters and call the Jedi Temple for help. On his way out of the ship, he spotted Fett and fellow bounty hunters [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]] approaching on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. As the bounty hunters climbed a turbolift shaft into the ship, hoping to find Windu's corpse, R2-D2 repeatedly dropped debris on them. After he dropped a downed clone trooper's [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]], the bounty hunters fled the ship, deciding to destroy it instead. R2-D2 proceeded to Skywalker's fighter, but was met by a gundark who lifted him from the ground. The astromech droid shot one end of his tow cable to the creature's forehead and the other to the fighter, and after escaping from the gundark's grasp, set the fighter to autopilot, sending it and the attached gundark rocketing into the side of the Star Destroyer. R2-D2 then climbed inside of the droid socket of [[Mace Windu's Jedi fighter/Legends|Windu's starfighter]] and lifted off of the ground, but was pursued by the ''Slave I'', whose occupants believed that Windu was flying the interceptor. R2-D2 evaded their laserfire and took the ship out of the planet's atmosphere, but a shot from Fett destroyed his communications dish. As he neared the two parked [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking rings]], Fett destroyed one, but R2-D2 locked into the other and took the fighter into hyperspace. Arriving at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, he raced through the temple's hallways and into a briefing room, where Plo Koon and Tano were in the midst of a briefing. In a frenzy, R2-D2 attempted to shove [[R2-Y9/Legends|Koon's astromech]] out of the room's computer terminal, but the scuffle was broken up by Tano. When she identified R2-D2 to Koon, the Jedi Master allowed him to play a recording he had taken of Skywalker issuing his instructions, and Koon and Tano immediately prepared to leave. They brought R2-D2 and a contingent of clone troopers to Vanqor, where they found the ''Endurance'' suffering from compounded damage and in its final throes. From an LAAT gunship, Koon and Tano used the Force to hold the Star Destroyer together while several clones rescued Skywalker and Windu. The gunship was taken a safe distance away from the exploding vessel, and as Skywalker and Windu were taken away on [[gurney]]s, the Master of the Order thanked R2-D2 for his assistance. ====A curious caper==== {{Dialogue|R2-D2|*beeps and whistles*|Hay-Zu|Ah. Big talk for a small droid.|R2-D2|*beeps and whistles*|C-3PO|Artoo! Have your senses frozen? I am not going to 'let you at him.' In fact, I'm going to switch you off before you cause an intergalactic incident!|attr=The last few seconds of Hay-Zu's life|src={{TCW|Nomad Droids}}}} When a deadly series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] shook the planet [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], R2-D2 and C-3PO were assigned to a Republic relief team that was [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|dispatched]] to the world—while the protocol droid acted as a translator between the clone trooper [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] and the native [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]], instructions on how to operate the delivered equipment were uploaded into R2-D2. After riding LAATs into a ruined city, the droids and Clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] were greeted by the Aleena [[King/Legends|King]] [[Manchucho/Legends|Manchucho]], who heralded their arrival as a sign that the "[[Deity/Legends|Gods]] below" would once more know peace. When a brief aftershock rumbled through the city, Wolffe dismissed Manchucho's puzzling claim that his team needed to "make peace in the ground" and dispatched R2-D2 and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] to the mainframe computer station. Inside the destroyed building, the astromech droid ran metrics on structural degradation. The results were negative, and he began to download his program into the main computer. Another aftershock hit, but an unworried Sinker left R2-D2 to his task. C-3PO arrived just as his friend was finishing up, and a small group of Aleena declared that they had something to show the two droids. R2-D2 and C-3PO followed them to a large hole in the ground that was mostly covered by a heavy seal. When yet another aftershock sent C-3PO tumbling into the hole, R2-D2 ignited his booster rockets and followed him down.{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}} [[File:Epguide405.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Kindalo surround R2-D2 and C-3PO.]] The droids found themselves in a dark, subterranean cavern, and R2-D2's glowrod aided them as they searched for a way out. What they initially took to be daylight ahead revealed itself as phosphorescent plants in the midst of an underground forest. R2-D2 sprayed [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguishing foam]] at a beleaguered C-3PO when what appeared to be glowing [[Insect/Legends|insects]] kept surrounding him, but the action caused several of the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to stand up and menacingly surround them. In fact members of the [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they demanded to know why the droids had come underground and why the surface dwellers has disturbed their peace. As C-3PO parleyed with them, [[Unidentified Kindalo 2/Legends|one Kindalo]] revealed that the ground had shaken to keep the surface air—deadly to their kind—out of the underground. The protocol droid offered to help them, and he and R2-D2 quickly departed when they were pointed in the direction of a being called [[Orphne/Legends|Orphne]]. They made their way to a chamber, where the glowing insects reappeared and [[Metamorphosis|metamorphosed]] into a [[Orphne's species/Legends|radiant female being]]: Orphne. Orphne told the droids that a covenant had once existed between the Aleena and the subterranean dwellers, but the movement of surface air to their world without going through the natural filtering process had effectively breached the covenant. Consequently, the underground dwellers had caused the groundquakes. When C-3PO offered to seal the breach and prevent more Aleena deaths, Orphne spoke a riddle before disappearing: "''You can run but can not walk. You have a mouth but cannot talk. You have a head but never weep. You have a bed but never sleep. Ask yourself, who are you?''" R2-D2 played back a recording of her telling the riddle, and as C-3PO pondered the puzzle, the astromech examined several decorated circles on the chamber floor. He realized that they represented the four elements, and when he reached [[Water/Legends|water]], he sprayed some on the circle. He had solved the riddle—the answer was a river—and he joined C-3PO inside the central circle as it rose into the air on a jet of water and carried them back to Aleen's surface. The two were thrown high into the air and sent to a landing next to the hole through which they had initially fallen. The underground air was rising through it and causing the nearby Aleena to become sick, and R2-D2 began pulling on it with his cable gun. An added push from C-3PO helped seal the hole, and the two worlds were once more separated. Several clone troopers arrived at that moment to retrieve them, and as they made their way back to an LAAT to leave the planet, Manchucho thanked C-3PO while an [[Unidentified Aleena child|Aleena child]] hugged R2-D2. With the clones ignorant of the droids' adventure, the group launched to return to their ship and proceed to a rendezvous with Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. [[File:Squishsquash.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The droids found themselves in a sticky situation following the death of Hay-Zu.]] ''En route'' to Republic space aboard [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|Gallia's ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], R2-D2 displayed a holographic image of Amidala, who told C-3PO that he was needed back on Coruscant. An [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|attack]] from a Separatist fleet ruined those plans, however, as the ''Venator''{{'s}} main reactor was hit and an evacuation was ordered amidst the arrival of a Separatist boarding party. When the droids spotted General Grievous engaged in a lightsaber duel with Master Gallia, they fled to search for an escape pod but ended up in a hangar. R2-D2 knocked the [[R5-series astromech droid]] [[R5-L26/Legends|R5-L26]] out of the way and rocketed up into the droid socket of a Y-wing, and after C-3PO reluctantly entered the cockpit, the astromech took them out into the unfolding space battle. After destroying one vulture droid, he turned and fled to the nearby planet [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] as the ''Venator'' was turned into stellar debris. A lone vulture droid followed them into the atmosphere and knocked out the fighter's reactor, but when it lost them in the cloud cover, R2-D2 brought the Y-wing around behind it and destroyed it. However, the Y-wing's reactor shut down, and the droids crash-landed into a marsh. R2-D2 and C-3PO exited the damaged ship and were quickly greeted by the world's [[Powered spear/Legends|powered spear]]-wielding natives: the [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]], a diminutive species who stood less than half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall. Both droids dismissed them as a threat just before being electrocuted by the [[Spear/Legends|spears]] and knocked to the ground. The Patitites tied both droids to the ground as they awaited the arrival of their leader; "the Big [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]]" soon arrived on the scene and banished the droids from the planet, but an offended R2-D2 confronted him after being cut loose. He appealed to C-3PO to "let me at him," and the protocol droid's attempts to prevent a fight ended with him inadvertently knocking R2-D2 down and turning Hay-Zu into a pile of goo. The Patitites cheered the droids for freeing them from Hay-Zu's despotism and set to work helping R2-D2 fix the Y-wing. While the astromech droid was completing repairs, C-3PO tried to introduce the Patitites to democracy, but his ersatz election caused the group to immediately begin squabbling over who had in fact won. The droids quickly boarded the repaired starfighter and left the Patitites to their new system of government; the backwash of the ship's [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] knocked all of the Patitites over as it lifted off. On their way out of the world's atmosphere, the droids realized that both they and their ship were running out of power. They accordingly touched down on the nearby planet of [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]], where R2-D2 scanned for a viable power source and led his companion off into the fog.
